# Nymrel Swarm Studio
> Local-first visual command center & action surety ledger for multi-agent coding swarms.

## Project Summary
- Name: nymrel-swarm-studio
- Organization: Nymrel (Parent: JalenBuilds LLC)
- Primary URL: https://nymrel.com/products/swarm-studio
- Contact: contact@nymrel.com
- License: MIT License

## Key Capabilities
- A2UI v0.8 Streaming Primitives: Decision Ballots, Parameter Sliders, Approval Gates, Diff Hunk Viewers, Campaign Progress Trackers.
- Multi-Agent Fleet Roster: Codex Sol (GPT-5.6), Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6 Pro, Hermes 3 (Local RTX 4090), Cloudflare Edge Sentinel.
- Action Surety Interceptor: Zero-trust AST interceptor with tamper-proof SHA-256 Merkle tree execution logs.
- Token Peak-Efficiency Routing: Real-time cost breakdown optimizing high-volume test generation to local GPU ($0) and edge AI ($0.0005/k).
- Workspace Inspector: Live multi-worktree AST diff monitoring with surgical one-click rollbacks.

## Design System
- Canvas Background: Warm Cream (#FAF8F2)
- Panels & Cards: Soft Linen (#F4F0E6)
- Primary Text & Dark Accents: Cedar Green (#2A332E)
- Brand Accent & Highlights: Terracotta (#A8541F)
- Border Accents: Warm Stone (#E2DDD2)
- Verified Receipts: Sage Olive (#3B7A57)
